newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK infrastructure shrs fall on fear of oversupply.
newsitem.headline: HK infrastructure shrs fall on fear of oversupply.

text.p: Shares in highway infrastructure related companies lost ground in the Hong Kong stock market on Wednesday on fears of an oversupply of shares in the sector, brokers said.
Investors are expecting at least two new H-share issues of China highway projects in coming weeks -- Anhui Expressway Co and Shenzhen Expressway, they said.
"It is possible investors are switching out of (listed infrastructure) stocks in view of similar stocks coming to the market," said dealing director Michael Ng of Sassoon Securities.
New World Infrastructure fell HK$0.25 to HK$17.45.
Road King Infrastructure Ltd fell HK$0.20 to HK$6.20 while Cheung Kong Infrastructure Ltd ended unchanged at HK$12.60.
"Investors are taking a closer look at the stocks and they will be more cautious and selective in buying them," said Joyce Leung at Sun Hung Kai Securities.
Analysts said highway development concerns Anhui Expressway Co and Shenzhen Expressway were expected to seek H-share listings in Hong Kong later in October.
However, shares of Henderson China Holdings Ltd rose HK$0.50 to HK$17.00 ahead of the release of its final results due later on Wednesday.
